column1: # Gate 1 security catalogue (WO-46, T-SEC-93, docs/03 Gate 1 "보안" row): every requirement of
# docs/06 section 2 whose stage column contains M, the test IDs that verify it, the layers they run
# in and the command that runs them. SecuritySuiteCatalogSecurityTest (./gradlew :server:securityTest)
# fails when an M requirement is missing here, when a row names a requirement that is not at stage M,
# when a listed test ID occurs in no test source, or when a manual row's evidence file is missing.
# Columns (tab separated, one row per requirement):
#   tests     comma-separated test IDs (18 appendix A, test/README.md section 4) or design test IDs
#   layers    where the tests run (source sets, UI suites, shell suites)
#   run       the command that runs them ("-" for a manual row)
#   evidence  comma-separated repository files a person reviews ("-" when there is none)
# Many T-SEC tests stay in the layer of the code they test (agent integrationTest, Vitest,
# Playwright, deploy shell suites): this table, not ./gradlew securityTest alone, is the Gate 1
# security suite. SEC-93 itself (stage G2) is this catalogue plus the CI jobs (T-SEC-93, T-SEC-93a).
